description: This file defines internal utility components for the Abseil C++ library, specifically related to function references and invokers, including type traits, union for function pointers, and static invoke helpers.

classes.name: VoidPtr
classes.description: A union that can hold either a const void pointer or a function pointer, used for type erasure in invoker implementations.

classes.name: PassByValue
classes.description: Type trait to determine if a type should be passed by value based on trivial copy and size traits.

classes.name: ForwardT
classes.description: Type trait to select either T or T&& based on whether T should be passed by value.

methods.name: InvokeObject
methods.description: Static method to invoke a callable object with provided arguments, using type erasure.

methods.name: InvokeFunction
methods.description: Static method to invoke a function pointer with provided arguments, using type erasure.

methods.name: AssertNonNull
methods.description: Template functions to assert that function objects or pointers are not null.
